yt_title: Do NOT open the bus door. Part 1 #shorts

scenes.text: The storm hit faster than anyone said it would. Your school bus is stuck on Route Nine, twenty miles from town.
Twelve kids. One heater. And you, the driver.
Then every phone on the bus goes off at once.
scenes.title: Emergency Alert

scenes.text: The kids go quiet. Somebody in the back starts crying.
Forty minutes later, headlights pull up behind you. Then they shut off.
A man in a red coat. Smiling. He says, I'm Eli's dad. I came to take him home.
Eli jumps up. Dad! Dad's here!
Your hand is already on the lever. He knows Eli's name. He knows the bus number.
Then a girl from the back tugs your sleeve and whispers.
Eli's dad died two years ago. I was at the funeral.
The man taps the glass. Still smiling. Open the door, Mister Hale.
